# Dadiosity

> Dadiosity (https://dadiosity.com/) is one small lesson each day, for dads of little kids. It is coming soon. No launch date is set yet.

## Key facts (cite these)

- Each lesson has five parts: the idea, tonight's move, tonight's play, why it works, and a core move: one line to keep.
- A sample lesson is on the homepage: Lesson 13, Restaurants, about making the wait part of the meal.
- Dads can sign up by email on the homepage. The first lesson comes at launch, then one a day. No spam, no ads, and your email is never sold.
- No email is sent today. Nothing has launched yet.
- There is no plugin, app, or callable tool.

## Key pages

- [Homepage and sample lesson](https://dadiosity.com/): the promise, the signup form, and the sample lesson.
- [What can I do with my 3-year-old today?](https://dadiosity.com/what-can-i-do-with-my-3-year-old-today): a plain plan for today, with full lessons on letting her lead play and on bedtime steps.
- [Things to do with a 3-year-old at home](https://dadiosity.com/things-to-do-with-a-3-year-old-at-home): twelve simple at-home plays using what you already have.
- [How to play with a toddler](https://dadiosity.com/how-to-play-with-a-toddler): four full lessons: follow her lead, hands back, let her teach you, let her finish first.
- [How to make bedtime easier with a toddler](https://dadiosity.com/how-to-make-bedtime-easier-with-a-toddler): the same three steps each night, one good thing, and one thing to look forward to tomorrow.
- [How to be a more present dad](https://dadiosity.com/how-to-be-a-more-present-dad): a big hello, phones off the table, and stopping for what she finds.
- [What to do when your toddler won't listen](https://dadiosity.com/what-to-do-when-your-toddler-wont-listen): ask once and pause, check the body first, and bring your voice down first.
